# Project guidance

- This workspace is the Distinct Youngsters Mathematics and Science Quiz, a dependency-free static website.
- Keep the implementation in vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; do not add a framework or package manager unless requested.
- Preserve accessible labels, keyboard interaction, responsive styling, and reduced-motion support when changing the quiz.
- Keep quiz content and interaction logic in `script.js`, visual styling in `styles.css`, and the page structure in `index.html`.
- Update `README.md` when usage or features change. Run the site by opening `index.html` in a browser.
